title: dendrophthora pendula
intro: Dendrophthora pendula, commonly known as mistletoe, is a type of parasitic plant that grows on the branches of its host tree, obtaining its nutrients by tapping into the host's vascular system. The health benefits of mistletoe include its ability to stimulate the immune system and potentially help in the treatment of cancer. The therapeutic actions of mistletoe include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of mistletoe include isopentenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
